description: Find investors that match a startup's profile. Filter by sector_focus (e.g. 'Artificial Intelligence' for AI investors), stage_focus (Seed / Series A / etc.), geo_focus, cheque_min / cheque_max (matches investors whose cheque-size window overlaps the founder's raise), active_since (returns investors with at least one round announced after this date — surfaces who's deployed capital recently), min_recent_rounds_90d (activity threshold), and actively_investing. Sort whitelist: total_score, last_investment_date, recent_rounds_90d, recent_lead_rounds_90d, total_funds_raised, min_cheque_size, max_cheque_size, last_mentioned_at — e.g. sort='last_investment_date.desc' to surface the most recently active funds first. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

active_since.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Returns investors whose latest investment is on or after this date.

cheque_max.description: Founder's maximum target raise: matches investors whose min_cheque_size is at most this amount

cheque_min.description: Founder's minimum target raise: matches investors whose max_cheque_size is at least this amount

geo_focus.description: One geographic region the investor targets (e.g. "US", "Europe", "Israel")

min_recent_rounds_90d.description: Minimum number of rounds in the last 90 days. Use 1+ to drop dormant funds.

sector_focus.description: One sector the investor focuses on (e.g. 'Artificial Intelligence', 'Biotech', 'Fintech')

name: search_investors
title: Search investors
